Untrusted content: attach_resource, create_push, create_service, get_build, get_connector, get_logs, get_service, get_session, get_skill, get_source, list_catalog_channels, list_channels, list_orgs, list_policies, list_services, list_sessions, publish_app, share_service · Private data: attach_connector, attach_resource, call_connector, claim_site, create_channel, create_connector, create_push, create_service, destroy_checker, destroy_connector, destroy_resource, detach_connector, detach_resource, get_connector, get_evaluation, get_logs, get_service, get_session, get_skill, get_source, list_catalog_channels, list_catalog_connectors, list_catalog_resources, list_channels, list_connector_tools, list_env_vars, list_policies, list_releases, publish_agent, publish_app, publish_site, publish_skill, reauthorize_channel, reauthorize_connector, set_checker, set_env_vars, set_memory, set_policy, set_service_access, unset_env_vars · Public sink: attach_channel, attach_resource, create_channel, create_push, create_service, get_build, get_evaluation, get_service, get_skill, get_source, list_catalog_channels, list_channels, list_orgs, list_policies, list_releases, list_services, publish_agent, publish_app, publish_site, publish_skill, reauthorize_channel, set_checker, set_policy, share_service, unshare_service · Destructive: call_connector, create_channel, create_push, destroy_channel, destroy_checker, destroy_connector, destroy_memory, destroy_policy, destroy_resource, destroy_service, destroy_session, detach_resource, get_skill, get_source, list_catalog_connectors, list_memories, list_sessions, publish_agent, publish_app, publish_site, rename_service, restart_service, scale_service, set_checker, set_policy, unset_env_vars.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
